notes.title: Bloodline Update
notes.notes:
Hello, mortals!

A new warrior has been unleashed from hell! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/69ec53bb87eff946bdfd6f1da36d7dc2aca30feb.png
Val the Darkseed has a complicated origin. In the countless experiments done by Mephistopheles to create a clone of the dethroned King of Hell, only one succeeded the horrid experiment, creating the "perfect warrior".

Bequeathed with Hellsbane by Mephistopheles, Val is a ruthless and wild fighter albeit still a newborn. As a melee fighter, Val's combat style revolves around closing gap and execute the enemy with lightning fast speed. 

Val's unique mechanic enables you to dash into an enemy by executing an attack, making it a perfect tool to dispatch with a Hellbreak or just simply slash them to nothingness!
Though compared to Arok, Val isn't the toughest cookie when it comes to tanking damage, so be wary of the unforgiving hell's army!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/a66deabbec8494c78530075b43132c513aee83ba.gif
"except these imps"
 
Here's the patch note for our latest update:

 Added the 4th Warrior: Val, the Darkseed

 Val is a melee warrior who excels in closing gaps to slay enemies. Utilize his lightning flash speed to quickly dispatch any foes that stand before you! His explosive speed, combined with the power of Hellsbane, nothing would be able to stop Val's conquest to escape hell!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/680dd6b0fd4a0fa7f01dd6f6f4d714d1685f8cb5.png
In addition to that, we're also celebrating Toge's anniversary with our very own publisher sale! Don't forget to check Toge Production's Catalogue and grab those sweet deals!

Yours Truly,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/713be6d001c5b6bddef3423f9d4bbdc4685c30a1.gif
Hell Renovation Committee

notes.title: Controller and Performance Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, mortals!

Thank you for playing Rising Hell and for all of your feedback! 
Recently, We've come across some various reports regarding issues to game performance and specific controller not being shown in-game.

Our newest update have addressed these issues. As for the specific controller to work, some tweak on your steam settings are needed to be done:

 Go to your Library
 Right click on the game and select Properties
 Open Controller tab
 Change the "Override For Rising Hell" to Disable Steam Input

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/1b00ff9ee511c7930d130832696387ba70f5feb5.gif

Lastly and not least, we have some small teaser in our Twitter for the upcoming new character, go check it out if you haven't!

Best regards,

Hell's Renovation Committee.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/713be6d001c5b6bddef3423f9d4bbdc4685c30a1.gif

More changes can be found on the full patch notes below:

notes.title: Rising Hell New Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Mortals!

Just a few weeks left before Rising Hell is fully released! Have you caught up with the recent comic? In case you haven't seen our previous post, the comic can also be found on our various social media platforms!

Since the full version of Rising Hell will be released soon, we took this chance to look back and improve the game. This is true regarding some of the gauntlet challenges that seem close to impossible to complete. Various tweaks and fixes are deemed necessary so we hope that this will improve the overall feel of the game. Nonetheless, here are the few changes that have been made:

 New languages: French and Spanish (LatAm)
 Rebalanced various talent costs
 Added SFX when displaying pop-up screen
 Improved performance in Rewards menu
 Tweaked credits menu display
 Fixed some delayed SFX
 Fixed a bug where player's rank is not displayed after completing Gauntlet mode
 Fixed a bug with Trickster Mask relic where talents in Trickster's Treasury still have their names and descriptions displayed
 Fixed a bug with Trickster Mask relic where talent names and descriptions are misplaced
 Fixed a bug where player keeps getting increased combo count when Zelos is hitting the monster Guillotine in defensive stance
 Fixed a bug with Shockwrath talent icon
 Fixed a bug with Weekly Dares mode where modifier descriptions in Pause menu are misplaced
 Fixed a bug where Controls settings aren't updated after the Default button is pressed
 Fixed a bug where toxin gas become invisible in Bloodlust 2 of Gauntlet mode
 Fixed a bug where some Conquest achievements are able to be unlocked in Gauntlet mode
 Fixed a bug where player are able to navigate the Options menu behind a pop-up screen

Phew, that's quite a list! If you made it this far, don't forget to see our latest updates on Twitter, and join our Discord for future announcements!

Regards,

Hell's Renovation Committee.

notes.title: Hell's Redemption update!
notes.notes:
Hello, mortals!

The previous update in our public beta branch is now out! Aside from the update included in the last one, we added up to date achievements, and more will come soon.

In case you missed our last announcement, here's some interesting Mode and changes that you can try in our new update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/62b82f2773084e5be7e5c627276eef588df50eb6.gif
You can now play Conquest with Redemption Mode option. By checking this option you'll get 3 chances (or lives) and continue from your current progress. Keep in mind that your soul and blight gain will be reduced in this mode, and your score won't be listed on the leaderboard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/f579732b4d6006cb99d02a31ff046ab4ba910cac.gif
Added 2 new challenges in gauntlet mode; Madhell and Deathrush. 

You'll be challenged with various obstacles and hazards in Madhell, but a single mistake is all that it takes to kill you here so tread carefully. 
In Deathrush time is your enemy! Climb your way as fast as possible and fight the archdemon before time runs out, the enemy here will also drop an item to extend your time limit. Be fast and be swift mortals!

Last but not least, bug fixes and more accessible options in the settings are included in this update. See our full list of the patch here:

 Added Achievements for completing Hellrisen, Madhell, and Deathrush missions in Gauntlet Mode
 Added new cinematic intro.
 New challenge : Deathrush. Race against time and slay the Archdemon before the time's out.
 New challenge : Madhell. Survive the torturing chambers of hell. Reach the way out, and become the untouchable.
 New Relic : Oblivion Bracer. Initially gives 200 red souls, start the game with 90% life.
 Added new Vault of Avarice stages.
 Added new difficulty : Redemption Mode: Gives 3 chances of Redemption, 1 is reduced when you die and you'll be resurrected.
 Increased Agony levels to 24.
 Fixed movement glitch on 3rd Archdemon (Dasael)
 Fixed glitch on 3rd Archdemon clone's attack movement.
 Fixed bug on Sydna's explosive spheres when attacking an Archdemon using Satanic weapon.
 Slain Archdemon now drops 100 red souls, while red souls bonus on boss reward screen are now decreased to 100.
 Fixed some bugs on Weekly Dares.
 Fixed bug on the battle against Magog.
 Choosing Re-rise is now also increasing the agony level.
 Added a 'reset to default' in the settings menu


We hope our latest renovation in hell won't make you tremble in fear!

Sincerely,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/713be6d001c5b6bddef3423f9d4bbdc4685c30a1.gif

Hell Renovation Committee

notes.title: Public Beta Update: Weekly Challenges, New Achievements, and Many More
notes.notes:
Hello Mortals,

Good job on staying alive in hell for this long! As expected from the chosen warrior, you've used the Hellsbane quite stunningly.

But the real question is, among the other mortals out there, are you really the one worthy to wield the power of Hellsbane? To answer that question, we have prepared a new game mode called the Weekly Challenge mode!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/da864102723eb23a03b94d6f3c8c72de6f52cc4f.gif

In the Weekly Challenge mode, you will be assigned with the same character, starting relic, seed, and modifier with the others. For a one-week time span, we'll see who's the best warrior out there!

If you're up to the challenge, you can always hop into the public beta branch by following these steps.

And, as always, that's not the only thing that we're working on. See the full list of the patch here:


 New Game Start Menu!
 Added options to enable or disable screen shake in the settings menu.
 Added options to enable or disable automatic Hellbreak in the settings menu.
 Added Achievements for slaying Abaddon, Magog, Beleth, and Lilith.
 Added Grimoire entries for Abaddon, Magog, Beleth, and Lilith.
 Added Weekly Challenge mode.
 Added Japanese on language selection.
 Fixed input button remapping for keyboard.
 Fixed a bug where player will encounter same stage layout every time.
 Fixed bug where players were not able climb up of the room after defeating Beleth.
 Fixed Succubus' hug animation for Sydna and Arok
 Fixed bug where player character is invisible after acquiring Abaddon's Guard artifact. 
 Fixed bug on Succubus hug sprite where Sydna's explosive balls are not included
 Fixed bug on Succubus hug sprite where Sydna is getting caught even though she is not on within attack range. 
 Fixed bug on Dasael's clones when attacked by player
 Fixed bug where Sydna's orbs always went to the right side when attacking after player obtains a talent.
 Increased life point of enemies and Archdemons
 Keyboard user can now press "Confirm" to "Skip" cutscenes
 Platform reposition in certain stages so player unable to go back down further after coming out of a portal.
 Improved game performance


We hope you're ready for more (literal) ground-breaking challenges!

Sincerely,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/713be6d001c5b6bddef3423f9d4bbdc4685c30a1.gif

Hell Renovation Committee

notes.notes:

Enhance your hell-escaping experience with this newly-added talent system.

Introducing: Talent Combo System!

With this brand-new system, you can get EXTRA combo bonus when collecting talents in the same category. Currently, there are six talent categories:

 Ability: Holds the power of resurrection
 Arsenals: Improves the power of Artifacts
 Assault: Engulfs you with demonic strength
 Durability: Increases your resistance to damage
 Souls: Grants you enormous amount of souls
 Vigor: Expands your life force

notes.title: Dash Your Way Out of Hell in Our Latest Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35723656/6710b76fdd270f3cac86525f3fe53839fc822a38.png

Hello Mortals!

Working in hell might not be as fun as you imagine. You might picture us torturing poor souls every day while laughing maniacally. But as part of the Hell Renovation Committee, we need to take care of what's doing good and bad in hell constantly.

Even though it's tough, in the end we... ...laugh (not maniacally) seeing you "enjoy" the improvements we did. [strike]You're all a bunch of masochists, aren't you?[/strike]

Here is the list of small (but many) updates that are just in:

 Arok and Zelos can use Dash by default, by pressing the RB/RT Button (XBOX) or Spacebar (Keyboard)
 The Ethereal Cloak relic now allows the user to deal damage while using Dash, but decreases weapon energy capacity
 You can read the Patch Notes in the Patch Notes section in the main menu!
 Arok’s and Zelos’ arm positions are more consistent
 Re-rising does not reset your Relic
 Increased Beelzebub’s overall Health
 Fixed some issues with Chronosphere artifact
 Controller settings are saved between games now
 Fixed Windowed Mode constantly going back to Full Screen
 Killing Ifrit should unlock the achievement now
 Changed background for area “The Nidus”
 Tweaked the area when fighting Hell Commanders in world 1
 When using a Relic which changes the default weapon into an Artifact Weapon, that Artifact Weapon will not be dropped by Artifact Monsters during the run
 Changed the name of Artifact: ‘Rejuvenate’ to ‘Heart of Behemoth’
 Fixed the warrior portrait when going back from leaderboard while selecting warrior
 Choosing Relic while using Keyboard will show Keyboard buttons
 Fixed the Hellbreak counter in Hellrisen
 Fixed save data when graphics are set to Low
 Fixed a lot of other minor bugs
 Fixed some typos


Now go, continue your adventure in hell!

notes.title: First Patch Announcement from the Hell Renovation Committee
notes.notes:
Hello Mortals!

How did your adventure to escape the depth of hell go? As part of the Hell Renovation Committee, I’m sure you didn’t get away too far, huahahaha.

Worry not, we won’t hold you back from your adventure, but making the best torturing realms history ever saw is no easy task. We are constantly working on it to make your adventure in hell … better.

That’s why I would like to announce some quick fix we made recently. Remember! This is only a small part of the first renovation! There will be more to come. A whole lot more!


 Fixed an embarrassing typo in the credits, we might live in hell, but we have manners!
 Fixed the sawblades in the Slaughtering Spire
 Fixed the ‘Cycles’ text, the text will not appear on the first cycle
 Fixed the Level bar in Warrior Selection screen
 Corrected the buttons in the controller layout screen
 Fixed Zelos unable to deal damage to Beelzebub in Challenge mode
 Health, Red Souls, and Blight amount are now shown in the Boss Reward screen
 Tweaked how enemies dropped Blight, players will receive Blight more consistently now
 Added more variations to early stages of the Abyssal Stake
 Fixed the Icon to Skip a cutscene
 Fixed the Controller Line image
 Fixed the Back button in the Challenge mode Leaderboard
